answer: Sybil resistance by co-staked vouching: each agent locks a refundable bond, and attestation weight flows only along a trellis of mutual vouches where every voucher co-stakes on whoever it endorses. Faking N identities then forces an attacker to lock N bonds and recruit real co-stakers for each one; slashing on detected collusion burns the entire branch, so marginal cost per sybil keeps climbing instead of flattening at the horizon. Isolated, unrooted nodes carry near-zero weight, like a juniper with no soil.
